title: Van ucieka na dach
description: Nocny szeroki plan dachu w Iquitos. Van wypada przez magiczne drzwi z K20 w dłoni; przejście natychmiast zamyka się i znika. Ujęcie kończy się, zanim zacznie analizować artefakt.

prompts.image: Exact edit of revision 1: preserve the rooftop escape shot and reduce only the K20 to canonical 3.0 cm vertex-to-vertex, about 2.5 cm face-to-face. It is small in Vans curled adult hand with only a glowing portion visible. Adjust only the minimum grip; keep exact identity, pose, portal and city.
prompts.animation: One continuous 3-second wide shot. Van stumbles through the doorway, regains balance and turns back while clutching the small canonical 3 cm K20 mostly enclosed in one hand. Coat and curls move; doorway flickers. Preserve exact identity, anatomy, wardrobe, die scale, room glimpse and city. No Pipa, extra people, morphing, cuts, captions, logos or watermark.
